authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.4.44, 20.4.45, and 20.4.102. The cloning field is absent in R13/R14, and CELLSTYLEMAP postdates those revisions.
checks: The generated AC1012 and AC1014 controls pass the candidate physical-source test. The AC1014 pair is retained byte-for-byte with no typed callback or output qualification and no object parse failures.

For each AC1014 frame, flipping a self-handle bit and recomputing the object CRC rejects the damaged frame while retaining the other. Strict ASCII and binary output preserve an existing destination; corrected import using the same adapter succeeds.
The version/class selector controls and focused AC1012/AC1014 transaction tests pass under ASan.
limits: Raw retention and complete frame disposition do not prove class bodies, native semantics, graph closure, lossless output, or whole-file support.
The out-of-version CELLSTYLEMAP and unqualified dictionary cloning/default semantics remain explicitly skipped; strict output is refused.
All generated and deliberately corrupted drawing files remain outside the repository.
